comment: The state of a device as the synchronisation reads it, and the patch a session writes (docs/synchronisation.md §8.3, §8.5, §10). `view`: the Mac-shaped `state`, the categories both devices ticked, the spaces set aside and the base give the entities (their fields, the marks are not compared: a fresh book gives one per field) and the lists of the snapshot a session freezes; played by src/main/sync/state-view-vectors.test.ts against the Mac's trackedViewOf and snapshotOf, and by LuciumKit (SyncStateTests.swift) against SyncStateView. `patch`: two snapshots and the spaces set aside give the patch (the `upserts` and `removals` are compared sorted by kind then id, the `remove` lists sorted); played against buildPatch and SyncPatch.build. Generated from the Mac's own code by a script outside the repository.

view.name: the structure only: spaces, folders, pinned tabs and favourites
the archive and the settings only
the open tabs category sends no entity at all
a space set aside takes its folders, tabs, archive and lists with it
an entity the base holds does not carry its seed fields
a state with one space and nothing else

patch.name: a field changed, a field removed, a field added: what each held is expected
an entity that arrives is created with all its fields
an entity that goes is removed while it still holds what it held
a list that is the same is left out
a setting that changed and a setting that did not
a space set aside is left out of the patch whatever the merge says
a kind this version does not know is not written into the state
an unknown field of a known kind goes with the others
